selection: Across three seeds, select the lowest mean validation joint-mirror MSE among variants with length MSE <= reference * 1.02 and dX MAE <= reference * 1.05. Include reference as fallback; freeze before new test evaluation.
test_policy: Evaluate only frozen winner and pro_v01; original 100 test rows have been inspected in past experiments and are not a fresh blind test. No test-guided variant selection.
quality_scope: Existing 1.0 Au-bottom numerical dataset; known Au loss-fit limitation. Inverse model research only, no forward model or FDTD run.
